qa.question: When did Caroline attend the support group?
What color is the delivery van?
What did Melanie say about the weather?
When was the team meeting scheduled?
What is the door lock code?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: I went to an LGBTQ support group yesterday and met several new members there.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: I'm glad you felt supported by the group and the facilitators.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: PARAPHRASE: The delivery van is white and it was parked behind the office building.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: The van belongs to the catering company that serves the afternoon lunch.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Melanie told me the weather will be sunny during the whole weekend.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: PARAPHRASE: The weekend picnic baskets are packed and ready in the storage room.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: The garden hose reel is behind the shed near the tall oak tree.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: The kitchen pantry shelves were reorganized by the volunteer crew.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: The volunteer team grew quickly after the spring recruitment drive.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Caroline coordinates the volunteer team and prepares the weekly rota.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: The rota spreadsheet lives on the shared drive of the community office.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: New volunteers receive a printed handbook and a name badge on arrival.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: The first aid kit box is stored above the reception desk near the exit.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: The notice board posters are updated every Monday morning by staff.

session_3.speaker: Melanie
session_3.text: The team meeting is scheduled for ten June at the community hall.

session_3.speaker: Caroline
session_3.text: The agenda covers the summer events and the volunteer schedule changes.

session_3.speaker: Melanie
session_3.text: The projector cables are kept in the cupboard next to the stage door.

session_3.speaker: Caroline
session_3.text: The refreshment table will be arranged by the hospitality committee.

session_3.speaker: Melanie
session_3.text: The parking lot gate is locked every evening after the last class.

session_3.speaker: Caroline
session_3.text: The lost property basket sits beside the main entrance staircase.

Caroline: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on 7 May 2023.

session_summary.session_1_summary: Caroline attended a support group and described the new delivery van.
session_summary.session_2_summary: Caroline coordinates the volunteer team with Melanie.
session_summary.session_3_summary: The team meeting is scheduled for 10 June.
